articles.title: Council Tables Footpath Repair Ordinance
articles.deck: Supporters and opponents on Fox Court disagreed about cost and timing.
body: The ordinance will return to the agenda at the next regular session, unless the chair calls a special meeting first. Staff recommended approval with two conditions: a traffic study and a public notice period of 30 days.
Councilmember Vera Nakamura asked for more time to review the proposal, which would cost about $7,500. Public works estimates the work will take about 37 weeks once it starts in November.
Residents of Mill Hill said they had been asking for action for years, and several brought photographs of the street.

articles.title: Patrice Rooney, 91, Longtime Volunteer
articles.deck: Friends remember Patrice Rooney for the many years of service to Marsh Landing.
body: Born in Marsh Landing in the years after the war, Patrice Rooney spent most of a working life in the trades and most of a retirement in the neighborhood.
Patrice Rooney died in March at home on Laurel Street, at the age of 91. Survivors include a daughter, two grandchildren and many friends from Marsh Landing.
Services will be held at the parish hall, and donations may be made to the Kettle Hill Block Association in his or her name.

body: To the editor: Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed.

articles.title: Then & Now: the Foundry Row Fire House, 1991 and 2011
articles.deck: A photo from the Millrace County Historical Society shows the same corner as it looked decades ago.
body: A 1991 photograph from the Millrace County Historical Society shows Oak Street from the corner of Pearl Lane.

Someone took the same picture from the same spot this month, holding the camera at about the same height. Most of the houses are still standing, though the porches and the trees have changed a good deal.
